input.summary:
Back hall morning room: lamp plan done and verified in a scratch copy (one standing lantern at 41,4,57 gives 35/35 cells at light 10+, 0 dark). Written at the end of parts/room-8.mjs build(g), but the build refuses it: the shell carves the room's air and runParts locks it, so the room is still 35/35 dark in build.nbt.</summary>
<parameter name="finished">false
left: The room is fully dark in the shipped build.nbt: 35 of 35 floor cells at light 0 (mobs spawn). The lantern write at (41,4,57) is refused by runParts ('REFUSED 1 writes into earlier parts ... 41,4,57 lantern air'), because mansion shell's box() fills the interior with air and the lock covers air.

Fix belongs upstream, not in this part: parts/shell.mjs (line 27, the box() interior fill of air) should leave room interiors unclaimed, or runParts needs a rule that lets a later part place into shell-carved air. I did not change the shell or the build library, since the brief says touch nothing else.

The designer's furniture plan (tea table, two chairs, plant stands, three chained lanterns) is refused for the same reason and is not in the build. The lamplighter plan assumes the furniture is absent; if it lands later, re-check the light map, because the table and chairs can shadow the lantern's reach but cannot block light through air.

Rebuild after the shell fix, then run mcd room --only "back hall morning room" and confirm OK with 0 dark. The verified spot is the centre cell (41,4,57), a standing lantern on the floor (hanging false, floor under it).
Hanging lanterns from the upper ceiling (y9) do not clear the corners at 8+ with one lamp: the vertical drop of 5 costs too much. Standing is the one-lamp answer.

waste.what: Found by trial and rebuild that the lock refuses lamp writes into shell-carved air, after the room-8 designer's note had already said the same thing. Each probe needed a full make.sh rebuild plus a room check.
waste.cost: 2 full builds (about 30 s each), 1 scratch-copy probe script, 3 mcd room runs
waste.tool: mcd room (or mcd plan) should flag any floor cell where the lock would refuse a write (cells the shell carved to air), so a lamp spot isn't suggested on a cell it can't reach. The 'LAMPS that would lift' list should list only placeable cells.

waste.what: Chose the lamp spot by hand: compared a wall spot (39,4,57, lifts all to 8+ with the far corner at 8) with the room centre (41,4,57, min 10), by counting Manhattan distances to the corners.
waste.tool: mcd light --rooms with a 'best single spot' search that maximises the minimum light for the room and skips locked cells would return 41,4,57 directly.

waste.what: Verified the candidate lamp by copying build.nbt, setting the lantern with the build library's load/set/save, and re-running mcd room on the copy. The copy stays outside the deliverable, in /tmp/lamp-check-8.
waste.cost: 1 probe script, 1 scratch file, 2 mcd room runs
waste.tool: mcd room --try x,y,z,block (a what-if placement that ignores the lock and reports the light, without writing to build.nbt)

companions.task: Re-open the room interiors in the mansion shell (parts/shell.mjs box(): leave the room air unclaimed, or let furnishing parts place into shell air) so the designer's furniture and this lamp can land; then hand back to the lamplighter to rebuild and re-check the back hall morning room.
